doc.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023

title: Italian brass players
summary: Rowe asks about Italian-named brass players and whether it traces to marching bands; the Tom Jones section was all Italian.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: You didn’t even get into the staff, right? Wow that’s a lot of pressure. And in sort of doing some preparation for this I was noticing the names Rubino, Triscari, Candoli, Morrello, Gozzo. And the vowels at the ends of these names, like what is it with the Italian brass player? Does it go back to the marching bands do you think?

I don’t know what it is. I always make a joke and say we’re the only ones dumb enough to want to play — to want to work that hard. No I don’t know what it is, there are a darm lot of — yeah that trumpet section with Tom Jones, it was a total Italian trumpet section.
